authorisation.source: author instruction in the Codex task after receiving the external panel report
authorisation.scope: freeze and execute a focused timing decomposition, correct the power and effect-size translations, report the omitted FNSPID drawdown, revise the manuscript conditionally on the timing result, and re-review
authorisation.evaluation_block_notice: This authorisation permits a post-review diagnostic on the already-opened evaluation rows. It does not amend the original pre-execution status of Notebook 75 or create a new holdout claim.

experiment.title: FNSPID assigned-window outcome-leg decomposition
experiment.objective: Determine whether the development negative-share association in the assigned-session open-to-next-open outcome is concentrated before the assigned open, during the assigned trading session, or after the assigned close.
experiment.evidence_role: post-review timing diagnostic specified after all headline FNSPID results and after the evaluation block had been opened

fnspid_firm_day_aggregators.use: sentiment aggregators, story count, frozen split, and assigned session only

notebook_75_results.use: reconcile prospective and realised power without re-executing Notebook 75

notebook_24_results.use: surface the already-computed FNSPID maximum drawdown comparison

pre_open_overnight.interpretation: movement completed before the assigned-session open; a negative coefficient is consistent with either pre-open information or assignment lag, not proof of either

assigned_session_intraday.interpretation: movement during the assigned trading session; a negative coefficient is consistent with some stories becoming observable after the assigned open

post_close_overnight.interpretation: movement after the assigned close and before the next open

assigned_open_to_next_open_audit.role: reproduce the published baseline on the same price-complete rows; excluded from the new multiplicity family

identity_checks.market: the same gross-return identity for SPY
identity_checks.note: The subtraction-based abnormal returns do not themselves obey a compounding identity; the stock and SPY legs are checked separately.

primary_development_family.population: split equals development and session_date no later than 2019-12-31
primary_development_family.estimand: mean daily negative-share coefficient from a cross-sectional rank regression
primary_development_family.within_session_transforms: average-tie percentile ranks centred at zero for the outcome and all regressors
primary_development_family.inference: OLS intercept on the daily coefficient series with Newey-West HAC lag 5 and a two-sided 95 percent interval
primary_development_family.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg q=0.05 across exactly the three new development-leg p-values
primary_development_family.baseline_exclusion: assigned open to next open is the published baseline and is not counted as a fourth new test

exploratory_evaluation_and_era_diagnosti.status: post-review and post-opening; descriptive diagnostic rather than independent replication
exploratory_evaluation_and_era_diagnosti.evaluation_leg_family: report the same three leg coefficients and BH q-values across them
exploratory_evaluation_and_era_diagnosti.era_contrast_family: estimate evaluation minus development differences for the three new leg coefficients with HAC lag 5 and BH q-values across exactly those three contrasts
exploratory_evaluation_and_era_diagnosti.full_window_contrast: reproduce the published assigned-open-to-next-open era contrast beside, but outside, the new family
prohibitions: no description of these results as held-out or confirmatory

interpretation_gate.decision_basis: two-sided 95 percent confidence intervals and BH q-values in the development three-leg family; point-estimate shares are descriptive only
interpretation_gate.post_close_only_or_dominant: If the post-close overnight coefficient is negative with a confidence interval excluding zero and the assigned-session intraday coefficient is not, the result is consistent with association after the assigned close. The manuscript may retain only cautious predictive-window language and must still disclose unresolved row-level timing.
interpretation_gate.intraday_only_or_dominant: If the assigned-session intraday coefficient is negative with a confidence interval excluding zero and the post-close overnight coefficient is not, withdraw next-open specificity and predictive-information language. Describe an assigned-window association consistent with contemporaneous arrival or assignment lag.
interpretation_gate.both_detected: If both intraday and post-close overnight coefficients have negative intervals excluding zero, describe the association as spanning both legs; do not identify a unique arrival mechanism.
interpretation_gate.neither_detected: If neither interval excludes zero, call the decomposition inconclusive and use only assigned-window association language.
interpretation_gate.pre_open_detected: A negative pre-open overnight interval excluding zero strengthens the timing-misalignment caveat but does not establish when a story arrived.
interpretation_gate.bh_rule: Whether each new leg survives the declared family is stated separately from whether its unadjusted interval excludes zero.
interpretation_gate.era_rule: The leg-specific era contrasts may describe where the sign change occurs but may not explain its cause.

effect_size_translation.main: multiply the committed Notebook 79 full-price-path coefficient by the pooled observed 90th-minus-10th percentile spread of the actual within-session average-tie negative-share ranks on the exact Notebook 79 price-complete model rows
effect_size_translation.sensitivity: also report the mean session-specific 90th-minus-10th percentile rank spread
effect_size_translation.prohibition: do not retain the hypothetical 0.8 rank-unit translation as if it were attainable in the tied regressor

power.prospective: preserve the pre-execution 35.4 percent figure and its projected standard error
power.realised: compute power at the same conservative two-sided alpha 0.025 first-BH-2 hurdle used prospectively, at the frozen development coefficient and observed evaluation HAC standard error
power.prohibition: do not call the realised calculation prospective

fnspid_drawdown.requirement: report both control and overlay maximum drawdown and the relative change, including the adverse comparison

singleton_stratum.n_equals_1_model: rank outcome on rank mean_continuous and rank negative_share; story-count control omitted because it is constant
singleton_stratum.comparison_models: recompute n greater than or equal to 2 and n greater than or equal to 3 with the original story-count control
singleton_stratum.claim_boundary: stratum-specific ranks and model columns differ, so coefficients are descriptive and not directly commensurable

claim_boundaries: The diagnostic was specified after the development association, evaluation non-replication, and external criticism were known; it is not independent confirmation.
The FNSPID checkpoint does not preserve reliable row-level availability timestamps, so no return-leg result identifies the true story-arrival time.
A coefficient is an average conditional rank association, not a causal effect or a directly tradable return.
The evaluation leg diagnostics are additional post-opening analyses and cannot repair the original study's low power or turn the block into a pristine holdout.
Do not execute Notebook 75, do not rescore text, do not rebuild the checkpoint, and do not pool FNSPID with LSEG.
Preserve null, opposite-signed, adverse-economic, and multiplicity-adjusted results exactly as observed.
